insight: Confirmed bug in git__status: runGit() does `stdout.trim()`, which strips the leading space column of `git status --porcelain` output. For a modified-unstaged file, porcelain is " M file" — trim() turns it into "M file", so the parser reads line[0]='M' (actually the unstaged flag) and misclassifies it as STAGED. Reproduced live: raw porcelain " M AGENTS.md" was reported by git__status as staged "M AGENTS.md". Fix: parse porcelain from the raw, untrimmed lines (or trim only per-field, never the whole record). Affects every modified/untracked classification. No existing git plugin test file.

git plugin: add tool silently runs `git add -u` (stages all tracked modifications) when called with no paths/all args (add.ts:38-41), contradicting the "never silent git add -A" philosophy applied to commit. Description doesn't mention the default → a model calling add with no args stages the whole tree. Also restore.ts:55-64 silently resolves a contradictory staged:true+discard:true to "unstage only" and drops the user's discard intent with no error — for an irreversible op this should be rejected, not silently reinterpreted.
